masked_email_target.description: Raw email recipients and SMTP settings are never returned as unmasked response fields.

masked_webhook_url.description: Raw webhook URL is never returned.

uses_global_smtp.description: Whether this email channel delegates delivery to the Control Panel service relay using globally managed application SMTP settings. This reveals no SMTP credentials.

email_recipients.description: Required for email-channel creation. On update, omission preserves the existing masked recipient set; when supplied, the array must be non-empty.

items.description: Bare mailbox address only; display names and CR/LF are rejected.

uses_global_smtp.description: Email delivery is delegated to the authenticated Control Panel relay backed by globally managed SMTP settings.

webhook_url.description: Write-only secret. Only http/https absolute URLs are accepted.

error.description: Optional sanitized error. Raw provider responses, target URLs, credentials, and tokens are never returned.

target.description: Masked delivery target only. Raw webhook URLs and email recipient addresses are never returned.

NotificationEventWriteRequest.description: Secret-free administrative notification event with structured source and detail fields. metadata and all other unknown properties are rejected. Raw credentials, tokens, webhook URLs, passwords, and authorization values are prohibited in every field.

action.description: Required stable dotted ASCII identifier; raw values are prohibited.

actor_username.description: Display-safe non-secret actor name; control characters are prohibited.

details.description: Optional display-safe diagnostic or operation details. Raw secrets, URLs carrying credentials, and control characters are prohibited.

resource_id.description: Non-secret opaque resource identifier. URLs, credentials, tokens, and control characters are prohibited.

service_id.description: Source service identifier. When omitted, the producer is treated as control-panel; the receiving Observability service is never inferred as the source.

status.description: Short non-secret status identifier. Defaults to recorded when omitted.

summary.description: Short display-safe summary. Raw secrets, URLs carrying credentials, and control characters are prohibited.

timestamp.description: Optional source event time. It is context only and not an outbox or idempotency identifier.

ObservabilityLocalRemediationTransition.description: The complete enumerated Observability-local execution scope. Host and cross-service actions are not representable.

RemediationProposal.description: Observability may detect and propose only. This object is not a grant and cannot name an executor, mint authority, or invoke Updater directly.

RemediationProposalEvidence.description: Bounded secret-safe evidence. Raw logs, payloads, credentials, configuration, and command output are prohibited.

diagnostic-rerun-response.schema.description: Result of re-evaluating one incident from its already persisted signal. It never changes the incident lifecycle or executes remediation.
diagnostic-rerun-response.schema.title: DiagnosticRerunResponse

post.description: Re-evaluates the diagnostic report from the incident's already persisted signal. Requires diagnostics.run and never changes incident lifecycle, executes remediation, or sends notifications.

200.description: diagnostic report re-evaluated or safely left inconclusive

500.description: persisted incident, signal, or diagnostic report update failed

200.description: notification channels without raw webhook URLs

400.description: invalid notification channel or webhook URL

200.description: notification channel detail without raw webhook URL

400.description: invalid notification channel or webhook URL

200.description: notification delivery history with masked targets

post.description: Accepts either the configured Control Panel service bearer or an administrator bearer authorized for notifications.manage. The request contains only structured, secret-free notification context; unknown fields are rejected. Raw tokens, credentials, webhook URLs, passwords, authorization values, or other secrets must never be supplied. event_id and outbox/idempotency semantics are not part of this endpoint.

202.description: delivery attempts completed; targets and errors are masked or sanitized

400.description: bad_request, event_type_required, or invalid_notification_event; metadata and other unknown fields are rejected

post.summary: Deliver a secret-free administrative notification event

200.description: verified remediation action / incident / stream context for Control Panel dispatch

409.description: incident context missing, stream context missing, or action is not executable

200.description: safe or approved remediation action recorded

202.description: signal accepted; incidents may be returned

get.description: Historical route name retained without introducing a /v2 URI prefix. This is an application-owned runtime identity probe consumed by the Local Executor during update verification; it is not Updater health. The current source has no explicit route-level no-store behavior. A later consumer implementation must emit the exact Cache-Control no-store response declared here.

503.description: Observability runtime identity is unavailable; the response is safe and contains no raw configuration

get.summary: Read the Observability application runtime identity

local_transition_schema.description: The complete enumerated Observability-local execution scope. Host and cross-service actions are not representable.

proposal_schema.description: Observability may detect and propose only. This object is not a grant and cannot name an executor, mint authority, or invoke Updater directly.
